name: about-renaissance
label: A regenerative Renaissance woman.
description: Brought across from a page made elsewhere; every word, picture and link is a field.

defaults.heading: A regenerative Renaissance woman.
defaults.text: I am a photographer, embodiment teacher, writer, artist, gardener, designer, mentor and community weaver.
defaults.text2: For much of my life I thought I needed to decide which one I was. Eventually I realized the question itself was too small. My work has never really been about any one medium. It is about

lines.lines: How we relate to the body.
How we relate to what has happened to us.
How we relate to one another.
How we relate to the living Earth.

defaults.text5: And how those relationships shape who we become.
